tagline: Cold lakes and hot ground on the same mountain road.
intro: From Old Station, Routes 44 and 89 lead back to Lassen Volcanic National Park. There the byway turns south on Route 89, past Manzanita Lake and over an unnamed pass between Lassen Peak and Bumpass Mountain.

Out of the park it joins Route 36 east of Mineral and heads for Chester on Lake Almanor. The short stretch of Route 36 through Mineral is, officially, not part of it. The loop circles the lake, then runs northwest through the Lassen National Forest back toward Old Station.

moments.title: Lake Helen
moments.text: Highway 89 runs along the southern and eastern shores of this cirque lake at about 8,200 feet, where the ice usually holds from autumn until July or August.

moments.title: Sulphur Works
moments.text: Gray-green andesite has broken down into red, yellow, and buff clays here, and a hot vent east of the road gives off hydrogen sulfide where the park road's builders put a rustic entrance station.

moments.title: Chester
moments.text: On Lake Almanor, the town’s name recalls the two Chesters, in Vermont and Missouri, that its founders came from.

practical: The section of Route 89 through Lassen Volcanic National Park is usually closed in winter.
